messages.subject: mediation with ordinal/binary variables (bootstrap error)
parts:
Dear All,

I'm very new to Lavaan. I am trying to run a mediation analysis for a regression model with binary outcome variable, and mix of ordinal and binary predictors.  X is binary predictor (GAScreen), M is ordinal mediator (Belief), Y is binary outcome (DCStress), and I also have a binary covariate (CogImp). 

The analysis is fine without bootstrapping and provides standard errors and p values etc.

But I'd now like to bootstrap the model. For some reason the model gives 0 successful bootstrap draws out of the 5000 requested, and it won't give any standard errors or p values for the regressions.

Can someone please point me to where I have gone wrong as to why this doesn't work in my model?

I appreciate any help. 

Here is my syntax :

> library(semPlot)
> model1<-'#simple mediation
+ Belief~a*GAScreen+CogImp
+ DCStress~b*Belief+CogImp
+ DCStress~c*GAScreen
+ #indirect effect
+ ab:=a*b
+ #total effect
+ total:=c+(a*b)'
> fit1<-sem(model1,data=mediate,se="bootstrap",bootstrap=5000,estimator="DWLS",verbose=TRUE,ordered=c("Belief","GAScreen","CogImp","DCStress"))

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: mediation with ordinal/binary variables (bootstrap error)
parts:
X is binary predictor (GAScreen),  and I also have a binary covariate (CogImp). 

Don't list those in the ordered= argument.

https://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/cat.html

Also, they are not really fixed across bootstrap samples, so try setting conditional.x=FALSE and fixed.x=FALSE.

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Assistant Professor, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
http://www.uva.nl/profile/t.d.jorgensen

Dear Terrence,

Thank you very much for your helpful response. Sorry, my attention to detail was poor when reading the tutorial on how to handle the exogenous variables.

I can confirm this worked for my model and allowed me to bootstrap SE and confidence intervals. I requested 5000 and it produced something like 4930 successful bootstrap draws. I am unsure whether the unsuccessful bootstrap draws is relevant but all seems ok and I am happy with the findings. 

Thanks again and best regards,
